تناسلت (form VI)
# تَنَاسَلْتُ (tanāsaltu) /ta.naː.sal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَاسَلَ (tanāsala)
# تَنَاسَلْتَ (tanāsalta) /ta.naː.sal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَاسَلَ (tanāsala)
# تَنَاسَلْتِ (tanāsalti) /ta.naː.sal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَاسَلَ (tanāsala)
# تَنَاسَلَتْ (tanāsalat) /ta.naː.sa.lat/: third-person fem
